children: Oilfield services provider's Q3 revenue grew 6% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS beat consensus estimates, rising 16% sequentially but down 7% yr/yr
Company repurchased 12.9 mln shares for $656 mln during the quarter
SLB says supportive market fundamentals remain intact, with energy security driving international growth
Company sees a compelling 2027 outlook, with upside as Middle East activity recovers
SLB expects international growth driven by deepwater momentum, US shale expansion abroad, and data center solutions
MIDDLE EAST RECOVERY - Co said international revenue growth was led by a 13% increase in Middle East activity despite late-quarter disruptions
NORTH AMERICA STRENGTH - Co said revenue growth in North America was driven by higher sales of production chemicals, artificial lift and valves in U.S. land, and increased drilling activity in Canada
ACQUISITION CONTRIBUTION - ChampionX contributed $956 mln revenue, consisting of $662 mln in North America and $263 mln in the international markets
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 26 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and 2 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil related services and equipment peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for SLB N.V. is $63.00, about 27.1% above its October 22 closing price of $49.55
The stock recently traded at 16 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
